findings.claim: Masked inputs silently lose their validity masks and can publish unavailable pixels as VALID measurements. Preserve the masks or explicitly reject masked inputs before coercion, with regression tests.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: decode_linear(np.ma.array([100.0, 300.0], mask=[False, True]), nodata=None) reaches np.asarray at line 180, which strips the MaskedArray subclass and mask. Classification at lines 234–242 then sees two finite positive values, so both receive VALID/NONE and finite powers. angle_to_degrees uses the same helper, and _bool_mask repeats the mask-stripping conversion at line 188. This violates PRD.md:415's requirement to retain product validity/noise flags and line 421's distinction between unavailable and valid observations. The test file contains no masked-input regression.
